errors.evidence: The description states that the regions on the x-axis are arranged in alphabetical order, but they are not. The order shown is Северозападен, Северен, Североизточен, Югоизточен, Югозападен, Южен. An alphabetical arrangement would start with Северен.
The description lists the value for electrified lines in the Southwestern region (Югозападен) as 663, but the value labeled on top of the bar in the chart is 660.
